notes.title: Mice update!
notes.content:
I made a lot of changes since the release of Ogrüuk's demo 10 days ago!
I hope you'll enjoy this update!

[h1]Save cute mice from ogres![/h1]
You can now collect up to 4 mice per level!
Didn't catch all of them? No problem! Just press [b]restart[/b] or [b]replay any level[/b] you already finished by going to the main menu!

[h1]Smooth experience[/h1]
- [b]Simpler[/b] and [b]clearer[/b] level design.
- [b]More time margin[/b] to finish the levels!
- No more squinting: more visible in game UI (like when we take a power).
- Went too far on a level or you get stuck somewhere ? There is now [b]stairs[/b] to get you back on track!
- A [b]simplified jump[/b]: added a margin to allow jumping a few frames after falling.
- Ogres can't detect anymore if the player is just behind them.

[h1]No more guessing:[/h1]
- Added lights to better see platforms.
- The area of delimitation of lamps are clearer!
- [b]Small text tutorials[/b] for ogres, lamps and crouching!
- No more need to press a button to save the dog, just go near the cooking pot and win!
- Need to better understand where's the player in 3D space ? I added a [b]small permanent shadow [/b]for the player so that we can keep track of its position.
- A light background to detach the pause menu.
- More contrasted buttons.

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
- Fps drop, especially on the last level.
- Can't win anymore on the second level by taking the wrong power.
- Grass wasn't visible in first level.
- Removed holes on the ground where the player couldn't get out.
- The player's head didn't collide with walls.

Thank you for reading, and I hope you'll enjoy the new content!

Loekni
